dodGroupGoverned.guideClause: If there are multiple Scrum Teams working together on a product, they must mutually define and comply with the same Definition of Done.
dodGroupGoverned.recovery: Change the shared Definition of Done from the definition tab of any team in the group.
dodGroupGoverned.rule: This team works with other Scrum Teams on one product, so it complies with the Definition of Done they share and cannot change its own.

dodRequired.guideClause: The Definition of Done is a formal description of the state of the Increment when it meets the quality measures required for the product.
dodRequired.recovery: Reactivate or add a criterion, then save the Definition of Done again.
dodRequired.rule: A Definition of Done must hold at least one active criterion.

dodTeamMembersOnly.recovery: Ask a member of this team to open its Definition of Done.
dodTeamMembersOnly.rule: The Definition of Done belongs to the Scrum Team that works to it, so only its members can read or change it.

dorRequired.recovery: Reactivate or add a criterion, then save the Definition of Ready again.
dorRequired.rule: The Definition of Ready must hold at least one active criterion.

dorScrumMasterOnly.recovery: Ask your Scrum Master to change it.
dorScrumMasterOnly.rule: The Definition of Ready is a complementary practice maintained by the team's Scrum Master. It is not a Scrum Guide artifact.

dorTeamMembersOnly.recovery: Ask a member of this team to open its Definition of Ready.
dorTeamMembersOnly.rule: The Definition of Ready is this team's own agreement, so only its members can read it.

teamGroupAlreadyMember.recovery: Leave the group it belongs to first.
teamGroupAlreadyMember.rule: A team complies with one shared Definition of Done, so it cannot join a second group.

teamGroupDodAcknowledgementRequired.guideClause: If there are multiple Scrum Teams working together on a product, they must mutually define and comply with the same Definition of Done.
teamGroupDodAcknowledgementRequired.recovery: Review the version now in force and adopt it.
teamGroupDodAcknowledgementRequired.rule: The shared Definition of Done changed after you reviewed it, so the version you acknowledged is no longer the one in force.

teamGroupLeadershipOnly.recovery: Ask your team's Product Owner or Scrum Master to make this change.
teamGroupLeadershipOnly.rule: A team's Product Owner or Scrum Master decides which shared Definition of Done it complies with.

teamGroupNotEmpty.recovery: Have every team leave the group first.
teamGroupNotEmpty.rule: A group whose Definition of Done still governs teams cannot be removed, because removing it would take their commitment away rather than move it.
